title: Changing Service Parts never changes an added Part Sales field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C.
  • Create a customer for this test with "Sales Representative - Service Labor" set to sales rep A, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" set to sales rep B and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" set to sales rep B.
  • Open the customer's Edit Customer window in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change "Sales Representative - Service Parts" to sales rep C.
  2. Save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Service Parts reads sales rep C.
  • Part Sales still reads sales rep B.

Step 2:

  • The customer saves.
  • Its page lists, in this order: "Sales Representative - Service Labor" sales rep A, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" sales rep C, "Sales Representative - Part Sales" sales rep B.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R14: “Picking a person, or "Unassigned", in the Part Sales field keeps that choice until someone changes the field or removes it. Changing Service Parts never changes it, even when both hold the same person.”
  • S4-E2: “A Part Sales field that holds the same person as Service Parts stays added. It does not change when Service Parts changes (S4-R14).”
  • S4-R19: “The customer page shows the representatives with the window's labels, in the window's order: "Sales Representative" or "Sales Representative - Service Labor", then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" when added, then "Sales Representative - Part Sales" when added. An empty one reads "Unassigned". The Sales Representative rows show on every customer, whether or not the customer has an address. The other fields on the page keep today's rule of showing only when the customer has an address.”
  • S4-R9: “The fields always show in this order: the first field ("Sales Representative", or "Sales Representative - Service Labor" once Service Parts is added), then Service Parts, then Part Sales.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
